4.4 Cloud Architectural Overview 
 
Figure 25 AWS Architecture Diagram 
Figure 25 depicts the proposed cloud architecture, designed to prioritise, 
scalability, performance, and security, while ad heading to the AWS best 
practices for cloud applications. 
To start, along the top of the image, with the EventBridge and LeaderboardScan 
Lambda, follows the guidelines on decoupling components (Beswick, 2020). 
EventBridge is a service that triggers various other services based on a certain 
criteria (AWS, 2024), in this case triggering the LeaderboardScan once per 
week. By scanning the leader board table, and pushing new events to the SQS
